structure.text: Current model lines are Omega AI+ (marked 'All new'), Edge AI and G Series AI (marked 'Enhanced').

Other /hearing-aids/ pages are topic pages, not models: rechargeable-hearing-aids, waterproof-hearing-aids, bluetooth-hearing-aids, apps, accessories, batteries, costs-and-financing, reviews. The report counts 22 pages under /hearing-aids/{slug}.
/hearing-aids/styles/{slug} has 7 style pages, e.g. behind-the-ear and completely-in-canal.
The robots.txt names http://www.starkey.com/sitemap.xml, but that URL returns HTTP 404, so no sitemap URLs were found.
robots.txt disallows /en/, /en-AU/, /en-CA/, /en-GB/, /en-NZ/, /fr-CA/, .aspx, .js, .css, /sitecore/, */thank-you and /pro-site-locator/ for all agents.

what.text: starkey.com is the consumer site of Starkey, a hearing aid brand; the footer reads © 2007-2026 Starkey Laboratories, Inc.
The executives page lists Bill Austin as Owner and Chairman and Brandon Sawalich as President and CEO.
The site sells through hearing professionals: it offers 'Find a provider' and 'Schedule an appointment', and has an Internet sales policy page.

where.text: The catalog is https://www.starkey.com/hearing-aids, which links the three model lines and the style pages.

The operations manuals page https://www.starkey.com/support/operations-manuals links about 35 PDFs, plus the Climate Disclosures and ESG Report PDFs that every page links. It covers older families (Livio, Muse iQ, Halo, Z Series, 3 Series), chargers, SurfLink and apps.
Manual PDFs are hosted on cdn.mediavalet.com (220 PDF links in the report), under paths like /usil/starkeyhearingtech/.../Original/{name}.pdf.

The Bluetooth page links Auracast Assistant QuickTip and Flyer PDFs. The compatibility page links the StarLink Edge LE Adapter User Guide PDF. The tinnitus page links a Tinnitus Consumer Brochure PDF.
The eifu.starkey.com viewer serves manuals as pdf?groupDocNumber=... (16 URLs). The example BKLT3014-EE-SC is the Mini Turbo Charger Operations Manual.

Apps: My Starkey, T2 Remote, SoundCheck Live and Relax (tinnitus) on /hearing-aids/apps. The support apps page lists My Starkey, Thrive and Hear Share. Store IDs are iOS 1549559068, 336938292, 6449296331 and 966601084; Android com.starkey.mystarkey.release, com.starkey.T2Remote.android, com.starkey.soundchecklive.release and com.starkey.tinnitus.
Support phone numbers: 1-866-637-9243 for wearers and 1-800-211-7789 for veterans.

summary.text: Starkey's official site (Starkey Laboratories): active, server-rendered, with three AI model pages under /hearing-aids/ and manuals hosted on cdn.mediavalet.com and eifu.starkey.com. The sitemap.xml returned 404.
